facts.fact: Axione Gabon states the ACE submarine cable system links Gabon to the international network and carried a significant share of national traffic, with full service restored on 4 June 2026 after a fault on its terrestrial section on 27-28 May 2026 (a repaired outage, so the route is in service).

systems.owner: Axione Gabon (operator under DSP for ACE-Gabon and SPIN)
